question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

__________ the flying bricks and bottles, the riot police kept calm.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amid"** means surrounded by; in the middle of. (के बीच में)

 
 
• **Example: **He remained calm **amid** the chaos.
 
 
 
• **"Amid"** is the correct word to use in the context of the sentence, as it indicates that the riot police were surrounded by flying bricks and bottles but remained calm. (के बीच में)
 
 
• **Example: Amid** the flying bricks and bottles, the riot police kept calm.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Beside **(के बगल में): At the side of; next to.

 
 
• **Example:** She sat beside him during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **About **(के बारे में): On the subject of; concerning.
 
 
• **Example:** We were talking about the new project.
 
 
 
• **Until **(तक): Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.
 
 
• **Example:** We waited until the rain stopped.
 
 

38:Tc04,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**
